## Architecture (draft)
```mermaid
%% DRAFT generated by analyze_capture.py. Complete it by hand (see assets/example-diagrams.md).
flowchart TB
  subgraph Browser["Browser"]
    direction TB
    Shell["MyEntertaining screen<br/>UBTConnect.Calendar.MyEntertaining.mvc.js"]
    subgraph Content["Rendered blocks"]
      direction LR
    end
    Infra["App infrastructure blocks (24)<br/>render nothing visible"]
    Cache["View cache / preload<br/>IsRestoredFromCacheJS"]
    Vars["Client variables read<br/>App_PIN_BiometricEnabled, App_Policies_HasPolicyToAccept, Embedd_B2CTenant, IsNavigateToHomeOnBack, PIN_IsLocked …"]
    Shell --> Content
  end
  subgraph Server["OutSystems server · screenservices"]
    direction LR
    S0["DataActionGetEntertainingConfig<br/>data action / aggregate, observed"]
    S1["ActionAppManager_SynchAppContext<br/>observed"]
    S2["ActionAppManager_AfterInitialize<br/>observed"]
    S3["ActionSync_Info_GetMain<br/>observed"]
    S4["ActionGetUserInformation<br/>observed"]
    S5["ActionGetNumberUnreadMessages<br/>observed"]
    S6["ServiceAPIFetchData_CacheableMapEntities<br/>observed"]
    S7["ServiceAPIFetchData_CacheableHouseholds<br/>observed"]
  end
  Backend["Backend<br/>not visible from the browser"]
  Content --> S0
  Content -.-> S1
  Content -.-> S2
  Content -.-> S3
  Content -.-> S4
  Content -.-> S5
  Content -.-> S6
  Content -.-> S7
  S0 -.-> Backend
  classDef unknown stroke-dasharray: 5 4;
  class Backend unknown;
```
